fullText.simplified:
十二、你到哪儿了

小黄猫：
    你好吗？希望你每天都快乐！
    我已经在路上了，这儿离猫乐园还很远，小白说还要走两个月。小白就是那只打过你的大猫，他叫小白，他会和我一起去猫乐园。小白知道去猫乐园的路，他帮了我很多。我们走了很多路，现在他正在睡觉，我想他可能真的累坏了。
    上个星期，我见过一只有意思的小羊。小羊告诉我，他在等他姐姐。他说他见过你，还说你在一个菜市场里见过他姐姐。真希望他姐姐快点儿回来。小羊还告诉我，你去猫乐园了。这真是太好了，我知道我没有走错了，你就在前面的路上。
    前天我和小白见到了一只大雕。大雕想吃我们。虽然他飞得快，但我们跑进树林了，他没有找到我们。小白说大雕的家在雪山，后面我们还会再见到他。小黄猫，你走了多长时间了？现在到哪儿了？离雪山还远吗？你可能也会见到大雕。虽然我知道你不会怕，但你也要快点儿跑，往树林里跑。因为跑进树林后，他就找不到你了。
    小黄猫，你累不累？你走慢一点儿，好不好？因为我真的想快点儿见到你！
    想你的饭饭
fullText.traditional:
十二、你到哪兒了

小黃貓：
    你好嗎？希望你每天都快樂！
    我已經在路上了，這兒離貓樂園還很遠，小白說還要走兩個月。小白就是那隻打過你的大貓，他叫小白，他會和我一起去貓樂園。小白知道去貓樂園的路，他幫了我很多。我們走了很多路，現在他正在睡覺，我想他可能真的累壞了。
    上個星期，我見過一隻有意思的小羊。小羊告訴我，他在等他姐姐。他說他見過你，還說你在一個菜市場裡見過他姐姐。真希望他姐姐快點兒回來。小羊還告訴我，你去貓樂園了。這真是太好了，我知道我沒有走錯了，你就在前面的路上。
    前天我和小白見到了一隻大鵰。大鵰想吃我們。雖然他飛得快，但我們跑進樹林了，他沒有找到我們。小白說大鵰的家在雪山，後面我們還會再見到他。小黃貓，你走了多長時間了？現在到哪兒了？離雪山還遠嗎？你可能也會見到大鵰。雖然我知道你不會怕，但你也要快點兒跑，往樹林裡跑。因為跑進樹林後，他就找不到你了。
    小黃貓，你累不累？你走慢一點兒，好不好？因為我真的想快點兒見到你！
    想你的飯飯

sentences.simplified: 你好吗？希望你每天都快乐！
sentences.traditional: 你好嗎？希望你每天都快樂！
sentences.pinyin: nǐ hǎo ma xī wàng nǐ měi tiān dōu kuài lè
sentences.english: How are you? I hope you are happy every day!

sentences.simplified: 我已经在路上了，这儿离猫乐园还很远，小白说还要走两个月。
sentences.traditional: 我已經在路上了，這兒離貓樂園還很遠，小白說還要走兩個月。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yǐ jīng zài lù shang le zhè‘r lí māo lè yuán hái hěn yuǎn xiǎo bái shuō hái yào zǒu liǎng ge yuè
sentences.english: I’m already on my way, but it’s still a long way to the cat paradise. Little Bai says we still have to walk for another two months.

sentences.simplified: 小白就是那只打过你的大猫，他叫小白，他会和我一起去猫乐园。
sentences.traditional: 小白就是那隻打過你的大貓，他叫小白，他會和我一起去貓樂園。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái jiù shì nà zhī dǎ guò nǐ de dà māo tā jiào xiǎo bái tā huì hé wǒ yì qǐ qù māo lè yuán
sentences.english: Little Bai is the big cat who hit you before. His name is Little Bai, and he is going to the cat paradise with me.

sentences.simplified: 小白知道去猫乐园的路，他帮了我很多。
sentences.traditional: 小白知道去貓樂園的路，他幫了我很多。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái zhī dào qù māo lè yuán de lù tā bāng le wǒ hěn duō
sentences.english: Little Bai knows the way to the cat paradise. He has helped me a lot.

sentences.simplified: 我们走了很多路，现在他正在睡觉，我想他可能真的累坏了。
sentences.traditional: 我們走了很多路，現在他正在睡覺，我想他可能真的累壞了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men zǒu le hěn duō lù xiàn zài tā zhèng zài shuì jiào wǒ xiǎng tā kě néng zhēn de lèi huài le
sentences.english: We’ve walked a lot. Now he’s sleeping. I think he might really be exhausted.

sentences.simplified: 上个星期，我见过一只有意思的小羊。小羊告诉我，他在等他姐姐。
sentences.traditional: 上個星期，我見過一隻有意思的小羊。小羊告訴我，他在等他姐姐。
sentences.pinyin: shàng ge xīng qī wǒ jiàn guò yì zhī yǒu yì si de xiǎo yáng xiǎo yáng gào su wǒ tā zài děng tā jiě jie
sentences.english: Last week, I met an interesting little lamb. The little lamb told me that he was waiting for his older sister.

sentences.simplified: 他说他见过你，还说你在一个菜市场里见过他姐姐。
sentences.traditional: 他說他見過你，還說你在一個菜市場裡見過他姐姐。
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō tā jiàn guò nǐ hái shuō nǐ zài yí ge cài shì chǎng lǐ jiàn guò tā jiě jie
sentences.english: He said he saw you and also mentioned that you saw his older sister in a vegetable market.

sentences.simplified: 真希望他姐姐快点儿回来。小羊还告诉我，你去猫乐园了。
sentences.traditional: 真希望他姐姐快點兒回來。小羊還告訴我，你去貓樂園了。
sentences.pinyin: zhēn xī wàng tā jiě jie kuài diǎn'r huí lái xiǎo yáng hái gào su wǒ nǐ qù māo lè yuán le
sentences.english: I really hope his older sister comes back soon. The little lamb also told me that you went to the cat paradise.

sentences.simplified: 这真是太好了，我知道我没有走错了，你就在前面的路上。
sentences.traditional: 這真是太好了，我知道我沒有走錯了，你就在前面的路上。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhēn shi tài hǎo le wǒ zhī dào wǒ méi yǒu zǒu cuò le nǐ jiù zài qián miàn de lù shang
sentences.english: This is great! I know I haven’t gone the wrong way. You are just ahead on the road.

sentences.simplified: 前天我和小白见到了一只大雕。大雕想吃我们。
sentences.traditional: 前天我和小白見到了一隻大鵰。大鵰想吃我們。
sentences.pinyin: qián tiān wǒ hé xiǎo bái jiàn dào le yì zhī dà diāo dà diāo xiǎng chī wǒ men
sentences.english: The day before yesterday, Little Bai and I saw a big eagle. The big eagle wanted to eat us.

sentences.simplified: 虽然他飞得快，但我们跑进树林了，他没有找到我们。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他飛得快，但我們跑進樹林了，他沒有找到我們。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán tā fēi de kuài dàn wǒ men pǎo jìn shù lín le tā méi yǒu zhǎo dào wǒ men
sentences.english: Although he flew fast, we ran into the forest and he couldn’t find us.

sentences.simplified: 小白说大雕的家在雪山，后面我们还会再见到他。
sentences.traditional: 小白說大鵰的家在雪山，後面我們還會再見到他。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bái shuō dà diāo de jiā zài xuě shān hòu miàn wǒ men hái huì zài jiàn dào tā
sentences.english: Little Bai said that the big eagle’s home is in the snowy mountains, and we will see him again later.

sentences.simplified: 小黄猫，你走了多长时间了？现在到哪儿了？
sentences.traditional: 小黃貓，你走了多長時間了？現在到哪兒了？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo huáng māo nǐ zǒu le duō cháng shí jiān le xiàn zài dào nǎ'r le
sentences.english: Little yellow cat, how long have you been walking for? Where are you now?

sentences.simplified: 离雪山还远吗？你可能也会见到大雕。
sentences.traditional: 離雪山還遠嗎？你可能也會見到大鵰。
sentences.pinyin: lí xuě shān hái yuǎn ma nǐ kě néng yě huì jiàn dào dà diāo
sentences.english: Are you still far from the snowy mountains? You might also see the big eagle.

sentences.simplified: 虽然我知道你不会怕，但你也要快点儿跑，往树林里跑。
sentences.traditional: 雖然我知道你不會怕，但你也要快點兒跑，往樹林裡跑。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán wǒ zhī dào nǐ bú huì pà dàn nǐ yě yào kuài diǎn'r pǎo wǎng shù lín lǐ pǎo
sentences.english: Even though I know you won’t be scared, you should still run quickly, head toward the forest.

sentences.simplified: 因为跑进树林后，他就找不到你了。
sentences.traditional: 因為跑進樹林後，他就找不到你了。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi pǎo jìn shù lín hòu tā jiù zhǎo bú dào nǐ le
sentences.english: Because after running into the forest, he won’t be able to find you.

sentences.simplified: 小黄猫，你累不累？你走慢一点儿，好不好？因为我真的想快点儿见到你！
sentences.traditional: 小黃貓，你累不累？你走慢一點兒，好不好？因為我真的想快點兒見到你！
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo huáng māo nǐ lèi bú lèi nǐ zǒu màn yì diǎn'r hǎo bù hǎo yīn wèi wǒ zhēn de xiǎng kuài diǎn'r jiàn dào nǐ
sentences.english: Little yellow cat, are you tired? Can you walk a bit slower, please? Because I really want to see you soon!

sentences.simplified: 想你的饭饭
sentences.traditional: 想你的飯飯

sentence_translations: (12) Where Are You Now?
Little yellow cat:
How are you? I hope you are happy every day!
I’m already on my way, but it’s still a long way to the cat paradise. Little Bai says we still have to walk for another two months.
Little Bai is the big cat who hit you before. His name is Little Bai, and he is going to the cat paradise with me.
Little Bai knows the way to the cat paradise. He has helped me a lot.
We’ve walked a lot. Now he’s sleeping. I think he might really be exhausted.
Last week, I met an interesting little lamb. The little lamb told me that he was waiting for his older sister.
He said he saw you and also mentioned that you saw his older sister in a vegetable market.
I really hope his older sister comes back soon. The little lamb also told me that you went to the cat paradise.
This is great! I know I haven’t gone the wrong way. You are just ahead on the road.
The day before yesterday, Little Bai and I saw a big eagle. The big eagle wanted to eat us.
Although he flew fast, we ran into the forest and he couldn’t find us.
Little Bai said that the big eagle’s home is in the snowy mountains, and we will see him again later.
Little yellow cat, how long have you been walking for? Where are you now?
Are you still far from the snowy mountains? You might also see the big eagle.
Even though I know you won’t be scared, you should still run quickly, head toward the forest.
Because after running into the forest, he won’t be able to find you.
Little yellow cat, are you tired? Can you walk a bit slower, please? Because I really want to see you soon!
Missing you, Fanfan.
